messages:
sara: FYI seeing an uptick in 5xx + timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu-west. multiple customer tickets inbound. opening this thread to coordinate fixes and comms. sample req-id below, more in logs.

mike-oncall: on it. can you paste one of the request IDs and the top error?

sara: req-id: req_0a1b2c3d, path: /v1/generate, gateway returned 502 after 4.8s. p95 latency for inference proxy jumped from ~220ms to ~4.2s over last 10m.

olga: seeing same in metrics: surge started ~12:06 UTC. error class shows 502 + 503 from upstream runtime. opening live traces.

alex: grabbing traces now. quick note — we had a model-serving canary rolled 11:05 UTC earlier (model-server v2.3.1). deploy-bot posted rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout detected: model-server v2.3.1 -> 100% (canary promoted) at 2026-03-17T11:05:12Z.

mike-oncall: ok, tentative suspect = canary. need to confirm whether traffic mix + new kernel path is triggering latency and gateway timeouts.

sara: logs attached (snippet):
```
[12:07:09] proxy: request=req_0a1b2c3d -> upstream=runtime-23 error=502 backend_write_timeout
[12:07:09] runtime-23: model-server v2.3.1 read loop stalled at attention kernel init
[12:07:09] runtime-23: connection closed by peer
```

alex: I see threadpool exhaustion on runtime-23 (streams pending ~920). when streaming requests spike, v2.3.1 holds threads longer due to a new post-token buffer path. patch in PR #482.

olga: can we immediately divert traffic away from v2.3.1 hosts? set gateway fallback to v2.2.8 and spin up extra v2.2 nodes?

mike-oncall: doing short mitigation steps:
- enable model fallback at gateway to v2.2.8 for eu-west
- scale model-pool-eu-west +30%
- increase gateway upstream timeout to 12s temporarily

rachel: I'll draft a customer-facing note for affected orgs. leaving placeholder for status page update.

infra-bot: k8s scale executed: deployment/model-server-v2.2.8 replicas increased from 12 -> 18 in eu-west cluster.

mike-oncall: command used:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment model-server-v2.2.8 --replicas=18 --context=eu-west-cluster
```

alex: started rolling traffic config to prefer v2.2.8 via gateway weight adjustments. patch PR linked here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482. it's small but needs verification; I'll continue with hotfix backport if needed.

sara: customer impact: 6 orgs reported errors, two high-volume customers experienced transient failures. support-bot listing tickets.

support-bot: Affected customers: org-acme (ticket 8912), org-pegasus (ticket 8914), org-lumen (ticket 8916). Sent initial ack with ETA ~30m.

olga: after fallback, error rate dropped ~70% in 6m. p95 latency back to ~350ms. good signal.

mike-oncall: marking this as contained for now. next: root cause analysis + permanent fix plan.

alex: quick root cause summary: regression in v2.3.1 — under high concurrent streaming load the new buffer path delays token emission and holds threadpool resources longer, cascading into gateway timeouts. PR #482 reduces buffer hold time and adds backpressure, but we need tests + backport to v2.2 branch for safety.

sara: action items from this thread:
1) backport hotfix to v2.3.1 and v2.2.x + run canary (owner: alex, due: 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC)
2) add streaming p95 / threadpool saturation alert and runway buffer (owner: olga, due: 2026-03-20)
3) update gateway to failover earlier to fallback models under upstream slowdowns (owner: mike-oncall, due: 2026-03-19)
4) write customer post-incident note and runbook for support (owner: rachel, due: 2026-03-18 12:00 UTC)
5) add automated load test for streaming + buffering to CI (owner: infra team, contact: alex, due: 2026-03-25)

olga: adding a quick repro runbook to the incident board: reproduce with concurrent streaming sessions ~800+ with synthetic tokens per request.

mike-oncall: final immediate mitigation wrap: reverted traffic to stable v2.2.8, increased model pool, bumped gateway timeout to 12s (will revert once hotfix verified).

rachel: posting customer update now: short summary + "we mitigated and are rolling a permanent fix; no lost user data; ETA for full fix 48h".

sara: thanks all. I'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow to run through timeline and ensure closure of action items. please add any follow-ups to the incident board. :white_check_mark:
